note: `rle_error_cleanup.owned_ptr` and `rle_error_cleanup.free_argument` are both semantic views over the vulnerable-original `rle_decode()` expression `out`: `owned_ptr` records the caller-provided output buffer on the shared `err:` path, while `free_argument` records that same `out` only when the branch releases it through `free(out)` (the fixed instrumentation emits NULL there because the corrected `err:` path no longer frees `out`). `cleanup_free.free_argument` is the exact vulnerable-original sink expression `ctx->desc[i].buf`; the Stage 04 sink marker is gated on the tracked `out` pointer so the trace records only the descriptor slot that re-frees the same allocation.
